title: On groups definable in $p$-adically closed fields
summary: This paper is about the $dfg$/$fsg$ decomposition for groups $G$ definable in $p$-adically closed fields. It is proved that for $G$ definably amenable, $G$ has a definable normal $dfg$ subgroup $H$ such that the quotient $G/H$ is a definable $fsg$ group. The result was known for groups definable in $o$-minimal expansions of real closed fields (see \cite{C-P-o-mini}).
